sources.title: F20 official PDF manual
facts: English printed page 06 says physical plates 1/2/3/4 correspond to app positions 1/2/3/4 and the food type and uploaded image order should match actual food.

Printed page 02 lists a double-click rotating the tray counterclockwise one notch to align it with app order. This batch refers users to the manual rather than asking them to turn a powered tray by hand.

Printed page 05 says avoid overfilling and close the top cover securely. Printed page 08 instructs disconnecting power and removing backup batteries for cleaning, rinsing and drying the tray, cleaning after every food change, and wiping the main unit dry without rinsing.
No photo recognition, eating detection, precise portion accuracy or live camera function is implied.

sources.title: Cats Protection sleeping-spot guidance
facts: Place resting spots away from noisy appliances and busy passages, leave sleeping cats undisturbed, keep resting places separate from feeding/drinking/toileting, and avoid washing all bedding at once.

sources.title: FDA pet-food handling guidance
facts: Wash bowls and food utensils with soap and hot water after use. Promptly refrigerate or discard unused or leftover canned or pouched pet food, following food-label directions. General guidance does not validate a specific feeder.
